page: OVHcloud c2-120 is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an x86_64 Intel architecture. It features 32 dedicated physical cores and 32 vCPUs running at 3.0 GHz, with no hyperthreading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 120.0 GB of RAM, providing 3.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is provided via a bundled 400 GB SSD, and the instance is equipped with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps and one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier for most operations. The stress-ng multi-core CPU performance registers at 49032.04, while the single-core performance is 1527.67. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block speed of 3545.25 GB/sec and a large block write speed of 38.36 GB/sec. Notably, the server demonstrates strong multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performance at 253.18 GB/sec, placing it in the top 25% of benchmarks. However, LLM text generation speeds are poor, yielding 37.21 tokens/sec for a small 135M model and 6.29 tokens/sec for a medium 7B model.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c2-120 offers a balanced resource density for compute-bound workloads that do not require GPU acceleration. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This server is well-suited for multi-threaded decompression tasks, software compilation, static web serving, and database operations.
